_meta.description: Socks for the fashion / outfit scenario.

hits.name: Merino Ankle Socks — Stone
hits.description: Merino ankle socks in stone. Suits loafers or derbies.
hits.imagePrompt: Stone merino ankle socks, unisex fit, ribbed knit construction, neutral gray colorway, flat lay styling.

hits.name: Cotton Rib Socks — Sage
hits.description: Ribbed cotton socks in sage green.
hits.imagePrompt: Sage green cotton ribbed socks, lightweight unisex crew height, fine vertical rib texture, soft matte finish.

hits.name: No-Show Liner Socks (3pk)
hits.description: No-show liners — for when the look says no sock but comfort disagrees.
hits.imagePrompt: Three lightweight no-show liner socks in neutral tones, ultra-thin cotton blend, minimal arch support, loafer-friendly cut with shallow heel pocket.

hits.name: Sheer Ankle Sock — Ivory
hits.description: Sheer ankle sock in ivory. Subtle detail with flats or loafers.
hits.imagePrompt: Delicate ivory sheer ankle sock with lightweight mesh knit, feminine silhouette, subtle ribbed cuff detail.

hits.name: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks - Navy & Cream
hits.description: Smartwool Organic Cotton Argyle Socks in navy with cream accents feature a classic diamond pattern that works for both the office and weekend. Made from organic cotton, they're breathable enough for everyday wear without sacrificing durability.
hits.imagePrompt: Crew-cut men's socks in navy organic cotton, classic argyle pattern with cream accents, comfortable everyday wear.

hits.name: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks - Charcoal & Gray
hits.description: Charcoal argyle socks with organic cotton construction that won't pill or wear thin after months of daily wear. The classic diamond pattern transitions seamlessly from casual to business-casual outfits.
hits.imagePrompt: Crew-cut men's socks in charcoal organic cotton, argyle pattern weave, everyday comfort wear.

hits.name: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks - Burgundy & Tan
hits.description: Burgundy argyle socks in soft organic cotton with a classic tan contrast pattern. Naturally breathable and durable enough for everyday rotation, whether you're dressing them down or pairing them with business casual.
hits.imagePrompt: Crew-cut men's socks in burgundy organic cotton, argyle pattern throughout, everyday wear styling.

hits.name: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks - Forest Green & Cream
hits.description: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks in forest green and cream with a classic diamond pattern that works equally well under dress pants or sneakers. Made from certified organic cotton for breathability and durability through countless washes.
hits.imagePrompt: Crew-cut men's socks in forest green organic cotton, argyle pattern with cream accents, everyday wear.

hits.name: Organic Cotton Argyle Socks - Black & White
hits.description: Black organic cotton argyle socks with a classic diamond pattern in contrasting white. Naturally soft and breathable for all-day wear, whether you're dressing up or keeping it casual.
hits.imagePrompt: Crew-cut men's socks in black organic cotton, white argyle pattern, everyday comfort wear.
